answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one lagoon reading each dawn to a public mirror ledger. Two random peers recompute each reading from the lagoon log against the mirror ledger; a false or reused reading burns it, and a rubber-stamp auditor loses 40 credits. Fees rise per filing in the dawn queue: first 36, thousandth 6,030; 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 36.
